verdict.rationale: Mollie's Subscriptions API automatically creates recurring payments at a specified interval, and this API is explicitly exposed as a tool in the official MCP server, letting an AI-native user set up recurring billing via natural language in Claude/Cursor/VS Code. However this is scoped to payment/billing recurrence, not general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduling (e.g. no cron-like automation engine, no scheduled multi-step workflows beyond subscriptions). Missing for 10: a general workflow/automation scheduler, evidence of scheduling non-payment tasks, and independent confirmation of MCP-driven subscription creation in practice.
